name: Japantown Cozy-Glam Apartment - ArchiveXL and AMM Preset
description: A decor preset for the Japantown apartment, available with ArchiveXL or AMM. Wood, marble, gold and dimmed lights for a glam and cozy feel. Kept key elements of the apartment for compatability with several Japantown mods and to make it feel like V gave the place a glow-up (instead of a rebuild).
